front: Order of steps when you type a URL?
back: Parse URL → caches → DNS → TCP → TLS → HTTP request → server/CDN → response → parse HTML → fetch subresources → render.
A: name → IPv4 address. CNAME: name → another name (alias).
401: not authenticated (no/invalid login). 403: authenticated but not allowed.
2xx success, 3xx redirect, 4xx client error, 5xx server error.

content → padding → border → margin. Use box-sizing: border-box.
Flexbox: one-dimensional (row or column). Grid: two-dimensional (rows and columns).

const: no reassignment. let: block-scoped reassignable. var: function-scoped, hoisted; avoid.
